item_short_desc: Rothco’s Security Officer Badge is a professional accessory designed to enhance the presence and authority of any security officer. Featuring a durable metal construction, this badge offers a genuine and polished appearance that works seamlessly with uniforms or badge wallets. Its pin-back attachment ensures a secure fit on shirts, jackets, or other uniform components. The badge’s compact design also fits easily into badge wallets, providing versatility and easy access when needed.
